name: esquisse
description: :exclamation: This is a read-only mirror of the CRAN R package repository.  esquisse — Explore and Visualize Your Data Interactively. Homepage: https://dreamrs.github.io/esquisse/, https://github.com/dreamRs/esquisse  Report bugs for this package: https://github.com/dreamRs/esquisse/issues

paragraphs: This addin allows you to interactively explore your data by visualizing it with the ggplot2 package. It allows you to draw bar plots, curves, scatter plots, histograms, boxplot and sf objects, then export the graph or retrieve the code to reproduce the graph.

whatItDoes.text: This addin allows you to interactively explore your data by visualizing it with the ggplot2 package. It allows you to draw bar plots, curves, scatter plots, histograms, boxplot and sf objects, then export the graph or retrieve the code to reproduce the graph.
